    <tspan>Planning a weekend in Portland</tspan>
    <tspan x="86" dy="17" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="10" fill="#CDCDCD">ChatGPT · GPT-4</tspan>
  </text>

  <g id="user-message">
    <circle cx="29" cy="111" r="16" fill="#D6D6D6"/>
    <circle cx="29" cy="106" r="5" fill="#343541"/>

  </g>

  <text x="76" y="112" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="16.79" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <tspan>Can you plan a relaxed two-day weekend</tspan>
    <tspan x="76" dy="22">in Portland, Oregon for me?</tspan>
    <tspan x="76" dy="21" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#CDCDCD">Today, 9:40 AM</tspan>
  </text>

  <g id="assistant-response">
    <circle cx="29" cy="190" r="16" fill="#0FA47F"/>
    <circle cx="24" cy="186" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="34" cy="186" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  </g>

  <text x="76" y="193" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="16.79" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <tspan>Absolutely — here’s a relaxed itinerary</tspan>
    <tspan x="76" dy="24">focused on food, gardens, and bookstores.</tspan>
    <tspan x="76" dy="31" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="600">Saturday · Arrive and explore</tspan>
    <tspan x="76" dy="25">• Start with coffee at Coava Coffee Roasters.</tspan>
    <tspan x="76" dy="23">• Wander through Powell’s City of Books.</tspan>
    <tspan x="76" dy="23">• Enjoy dinner in the Pearl District.</tspan>
    <tspan x="76" dy="31" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="600">Sunday · Slow morning</tspan>
    <tspan x="76" dy="25">• Visit the International Rose Test Garden.</tspan>
    <tspan x="76" dy="23">• Have brunch and browse Alberta Arts.</tspan>
    <tspan x="76" dy="31" fill="#D6D6D6">Drafting a few dinner recommendations</tspan>
    <tspan x="76" dy="18" fill="#0FA47F">● ● ●</tspan>
  </text>

    <rect x="140" y="462" width="13" height="13" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  </g>

  <line x1="20" y1="510" x2="408" y2="510" stroke="#444654" stroke-width="1"/>

    <rect x="20" y="528" width="117" height="34" rx="8" fill="#3E3F4B"/>

    <tspan>Find a hotel</tspan>
    <tspan x="154">Packing list</tspan>
    <tspan x="279">Best dinner spots</tspan>
  </text>

  <g id="composer">
    <rect x="18" y="590" width="392" height="67" rx="8" fill="#40414F"/>

  </g>

  <text x="60" y="628" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="16.79" fill="#CDCDCD">
    <tspan>Message ChatGPT</tspan>
  </text>

  <g id="footer">
    <text x="214" y="697" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#CDCDCD">
      <tspan>ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.</tspan>
      <tspan x="214" dy="15">ChatGPT May 2026 · Version 1.2026.196</tspan>
